item.title: Syringe Organizer Tray for Nurse Injectors
item.description: A tray that keeps syringes sorted and in their place, on a work surface, a desk or in a drawer. It's built for medical aesthetics work, where you want to reach for something and find it right where you left it. We make each one to order in our small shop in Canada, 3D printed in PLA plastic. It also makes a practical gift for a nurse injector in your life.
